description:
Store multiple memories at once. Same rules as memory_add, applied per item.

SHAPE: one ITEM here == one memory_add call. Same field names, same meaning. The ONLY
difference is the container: memory_add takes them as flat parameters, this takes a list
of objects. An item object belongs in the "memories" array and NOWHERE else -- never
paste one into a text field such as memory_add(content=) or memory_edit(content=).

BEFORE params, per memory decide: (1) TYPE? (2) what search finds it? (3) happened, or aspirational?
Each: atomic, front-loaded, self-contained -- subject + WHY in sentence 1, stands alone.
  GOOD {"content": "User prefers tabs in Python and JS -- consistency across codebase", "topics": ["user", "tabs", "python", "javascript"], "macro_topics": ["style"], "type": "preference"}
  BAD  {"content": "Prefers tabs", "topics": ["formatting"]}  (no subject, unsearchable)
aspirational (not yet done) -> add topic "aspirational".
topics: search words, single lowercase, no _ or -. First "user" for preferences.
task -> title + steps[] (milestones), or content with "- [ ]". task_done when complete.

collection.description: Shared collection by name. Omit=default. "me"/"personal"/agent name=own namespace; "owner"/"parent"=account primary (member-gated).

memories.description: Array of memory objects to store

artifact.description: Commit SHA or filename. Injected into topics automatically.

content.description: The memory text, plain prose only. Self-contained -- name the subject, include why. Put topics, macro_topics and type in their own fields on this item, never inside this text.

macro_topics.description: The project or domain this item is ABOUT — decide this first. 1-3 lowercase. Optional but almost always applies; it keeps the project label out of the content. Searched exactly like topics.

ref.description: Parent task or ticket ID. Injected into topics automatically.

scope.description: Storage scope. Default global. Honoured per item (was already read by the service, just undeclared here).

status.description: Initial task status. Works with both title and content.

steps.description: Checklist items for structured task creation. Each becomes a checkbox.

summary.description: Prose task summary — state/blockers/decisions. Renders as "## Summary" block. Requires type="task" or "task_done".

title.description: Task title (structured creation). Server renders markdown blob. Cannot combine with content.

topics.description: REQUIRED. Then the specific searchable keywords. Single lowercase words, no _ or -. Include related systems. Do NOT repeat macro_topics.

type.description: fact, preference, decision, path, task, task_done, result

signal.description: Also signal recipient with ALL stored ids. Needs a SHARED collection ("me"/personal rejected up-front — nothing stored).

name: memory_add_batch
